bio_md:
# 宋恭帝 · 主要事迹

赵显为[[s-song-du|度宗]]之子，咸淳十年（1274）以四岁即位，谢太后临朝，改元德祐。

德祐元年（1275）贾似道督师丁家洲，一触即溃，宋军主力尽丧，元军长驱临安。德祐二年（1276）伯颜入临安，恭帝奉表降元，与太后等北狩大都，降封瀛国公，南宋正统遂移于南奔之[[s-song-duan|二王]]。

恭帝北迁后习佛，后居吐蕃，史传至治三年（1323）被赐死。幼冲亡国，世多哀之。

bio_parts_en.value:
, ascended at four in 1274 under Grand Empress Dowager Xie, era Deyou.

In 1275 Jia Sidao took the field at Dingjiazhuang and collapsed at the first clash; the main army was lost and the Yuan armies drove on Lin'an. In 1276 Bayan entered Lin'an; Gongzong submitted and was taken north with the dowagers, reduced to Duke of Ying. The Song cause passed to the fleeing princes

.

In the north he took up Buddhism and lived in Tibet; tradition holds he was put to death in 1323. A child who lost a state - history pities him.
